mechanism: Trazodone potentiates serotonergic activity while lisdexamfetamine increases catecholamine release and has indirect serotonergic effects, creating additive CNS stimulation and potential serotonin syndrome risk.
action: Monitor for signs of serotonin syndrome (agitation, tremor, hyperthermia, hyperreflexia) and excessive CNS stimulation; use combination cautiously with dose optimization and patient education.
